description: Daily boom-candidate ranking history: one list per ET day (last pipeline run of the day wins; days before Oct 5, 2026 rebuilt from the published dashboard's git history). price = that day's latest close (native currency) with USD/CAD equivalents; price_now = latest close; chg_since_pct in native currency. Rules changed on Oct 2, 2026 ~10 PM ET from source-quality (v1) to upside-to-risk combined v4/v5; the last old-rules list is the entry with before_switch=true.

v1.label: Old rules: source quality
v1.detail: Jev impact × size/run-up/liquidity weights (boom_score_old): how strong the story and its source looked

v3.label: Upside-first (v3)
v3.detail: upside_score: payoff vs size, room to run, catalyst, trend

v4.label: New rules: upside ÷ risk (combined v4)
v4.detail: filters → price confirmation → ranked by upside ÷ risk to the stop

v5.label: New rules: upside ÷ risk, small caps first
v5.detail: combined v4 (filters → price confirmation → upside ÷ risk) × size weight; mega caps in a separate strip
